title: Kagamine Rin — Idol On Cake♪〔Part1〕Side Story (Part 1)

rows.Line: Tenma Household - Living Room

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Hmm... I feel like this part of the cake's missing something...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Saki! Saki!
Here! You can decorate them with these shiny thingies!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Thanks, Emu!
I'll try putting on a couple...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: I've got some of those decorative candies left over here too.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
I can use these?
Thank you so much!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: (It wasn't all easy, but it looks like their cakes are gonna turn out really great♪)

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: (At the same time, I didn't know what was gonna happen when Shizuku and the others showed up at the door.)

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: We...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: We were just practicing a dance routine here!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: (Thank goodness they managed to talk their way out of that.)

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: (They all worked so hard on these cakes, so I'm sure everyone receiving them will smile from ear to ear when they see them.)

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: (Also, would Miku and the others like it if I made some chocolates for them...?)

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: (Yeah...!)

rows.Speaker: Saki, Airi & Emu
rows.Line: We're done!!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
Nice work, you two!
These cakes look absolutely amazing!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Hehe. It's all thanks to you, Airi♪

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Yup yup☆
Tsukasa and the others won't know what to do with themselves when they see this!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
Alright, now to clean everything.
We have a big pile of stuff to wash, so we should get started.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Okay! I'll carry all the bowls and rubber spatulas to the sink...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: I'll help you carry stuff.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Sounds good. I'll start gathering up all the ingredients we didn't end up using...

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: (Now's my chance!)

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: <Airi, do you have a second?>

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Hey, Rin. Sure, what's up?

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: <So... I want to put together a gift for Miku and the others too.>

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: <Is there anything that you think I can make...?>

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Well...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: If you're going to make it, you'll have to do it in SEKAI.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Which means you won't have access to a stove or oven, so it'd have to be something that doesn't require baking or cooking...

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: <So I guess that's a no, huh...?>

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
No, not necessarily.
Let's meet in SEKAI tonight to work out something!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: <Okay! Thanks, Airi!>
bgm_area00002
Stage SEKAI

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Hey, Rin, thanks for waiting.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: No, thank you for meeting with me like this!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: I really appreciate you doing this for me. I know you had a lot to deal with today.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: What are you saying? I was able to fool Shizuku and the others because of you, Rin.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Also, don't forget that you're a valued member of the Secret Valentine's Day Alliance! I'm here to help if you ever need it!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
Airi...!
Thank you so much! I promise to try my best!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Good. That's what I like to hear!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: As for what you can make, how about some crunchy chocolate clusters?

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
I know what those are!
Chunky, crunchy, chocolatey deliciousness!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Exactly. We can make them right here too since they don't require a stove or oven.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Not only that, you can make them in all shapes and sizes! Here, check some of these out!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Wow...! Some are round, some are square and some even look like hearts and stars!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Oh, they're more colorful than I was expecting too! These look amazing!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Hehe. See any cute ones you like?

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Yeah! Wait, this one's also really cute...!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: You're right. A bar instead of clusters, huh?

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: I had trouble choosing between this and the round one, but this should be easy to decorate and wrap in something cute♪

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Good call! Then, why don't we go with this?

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Also, feel free to use the rest of the ingredients we had left over from baking our cakes.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Now, that just leaves how you're gonna wrap these! I'll try looking for something suitable.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Thanks, Airi!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: In the meantime, I'll look for a place where we can make these without being found out by Miku or anyone else!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
Great, thanks!
While you're at it, try coming up with some decoration ideas for your gift.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Okay!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
Alright, Secret Valentine's Day Alliance!
One final effort for one final surprise!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Yeah♪
